title: In the chromeless compact fallback (budget<=4) the '…N more' overflow hint is i…
body: In the chromeless compact fallback (budget<=4) the '…N more' overflow hint is intentionally dropped, so in a very short pane with many truncated stories the operator loses the truncation indicator. This is a documented, in-scope tradeoff of US-001 (keybar visibility wins over the hint), not a defect; noting only as a future UX consideration.
